According to the CampusHelp knowledge base:

1. Open the CampusHelp login page.
2. Select "Forgot password".
3. Enter your registered email address.
4. Open the password-reset email.
5. Select the reset link and choose a new password.

The reset link expires after 30 minutes.

Source: password_reset.md

Check whether your payment provider reports the transaction
as successful, pending or failed.

If money was deducted but CampusHelp does not show a successful
purchase, contact support before attempting another payment.

According to the CampusHelp knowledge base:

A successfully purchased course may take up to 10 minutes
to appear in "My Courses".

Refresh the page after 10 minutes.
Confirm that you signed in using the account used for the purchase.

If the course is still missing, contact support with the course
name and purchase reference.

Source: course_access.md

According to the CampusHelp knowledge base:

1. Check your internet connection.
2. Refresh the page.
3. Try another browser.

If the problem continues, provide the course name,
lesson title and displayed error message to support.
